interrupted_unknown_calls.delivery_score_policy: zero unless a subsequent independently accepted delivery exists
interrupted_unknown_calls.elapsed_policy: last checkpoint lower bound; actual native completion time unknown

budget_policy.wall: original round wall elapsed plus downtime; no reset
budget_policy.active: saved active work plus new work; no-process downtime excluded
budget_policy.provider_backoff: saved counters and streak retained; remaining cooldown ages with downtime
